question: Welcher Encoder ist von einem französischen oder deutschen Anbieter am günstigsten?
query:
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?result WHERE {
  # select products that are encoders
  ?result a pv:Product ;
          rdfs:label ?label ;
          pv:price ?price ;
          pv:hasSupplier ?supplier .
  FILTER regex(?label, "Encoder", "i")

  # supplier is from France or Germany (allow resource or literal)
  ?supplier ?supProp ?countryVal .
  OPTIONAL { ?countryVal rdfs:label ?countryLabel . }
  FILTER (
    ?countryVal = dbpedia:France ||
    ?countryVal = dbpedia:Germany ||
    (isLiteral(?countryVal) && lcase(str(?countryVal)) IN ("france","germany","deutschland","frankreich")) ||
    (bound(?countryLabel) && lcase(str(?countryLabel)) IN ("france","germany","deutschland","frankreich"))
  )
}
ORDER BY xsd:decimal(REPLACE(str(?price), "[^0-9\\.-]", ""))
LIMIT 1

question: Welche Abteilungen haben mehr als fünf Mitarbeiter, und könnten Sie den Namen jeder Abteilung zusammen mit der Anzahl ihrer Mitarbeiter auflisten?
query:
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX dbpedia: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX wgs84: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>

SELECT ?dept ?name (COUNT(DISTINCT ?emp) AS ?numEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?dept a pv:Department .
  OPTIONAL { ?dept rdfs:label ?label. }
  OPTIONAL { ?dept foaf:name ?fname. }
  BIND(COALESCE(?label, ?fname, STR(?dept)) AS ?name)

  {
    # Employees who are direct reports of the department's manager(s)
    ?dept pv:hasManager ?mgr .
    ?mgr pv:hasDirectReport ?emp .
  }
  UNION
  {
    # Employees who are members of the department (modeled that way)
    ?emp pv:memberOf ?dept .
  }
}
GROUP BY ?dept ?name
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?emp) > 5)
ORDER BY DESC(?numEmployees)
